font.reason: Vazirmatn is a neutral variable Persian UI face with dependable joining, Persian punctuation and ZWNJ coverage. It matches the original collaborative-canvas/product tone and supplies a real 700 weight for the compact identity badges and headline cameo.

comps.name: CursorCastEnsemble

rtlDecisions.what: Five identity names: Lisa, Lucas, Marta, Niko, Rita
rtlDecisions.action: Translated as لیزا، لوکاس، مارتا، نیکو، ریتا and rendered with FaRoot/Vazirmatn.
rtlDecisions.why: Names are on-screen identity labels; Persian transliteration removes leftover Latin while preserving identity and color coding.

rtlDecisions.what: Cursor badge placement and pointer geometry
rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original physical left/top attachment, SVG silhouette, paths, positions and trajectories unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The cursor is an actor and its physical pointer-to-badge relationship is scene choreography, not a reading-order layout.

rtlDecisions.action: Localized to the compact idiomatic Persian sentence «مشتری‌ها دوستش دارند»، right-aligned in the note, with typeOn() prefix slicing and no letter spacing.
rtlDecisions.why: RTL text should type from the right with valid contextual shaping. The compact wording preserves the source single-line composition and the exact 58–118 frame beat.

rtlDecisions.action: Replaced physical marginLeft with marginInlineStart inside the RTL text run; kept 8-frame blink and dimensions.
rtlDecisions.why: The caret remains at the RTL inline edge without changing its original timing or blink rhythm.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the gray physical canvas, generated notes, random seed 88, note rotations and all motion unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: These are non-text physical/environmental elements; no reading-direction meaning requires mirroring.

comps.rasterHandling: None. The scene uses CSS-generated canvas/sticky-note shapes and inline SVG cursors; no raster asset contains text.
comps.timing: All source timing, spring parameters, seed, drift frequencies, gather easing and 140-frame duration are unchanged. The shorter Persian cameo keeps the original 58–118 start/end beats.

comps.name: CursorDialogueDuet

rtlDecisions.action: Translated as طراح and توسعه‌دهنده, including the Persian نیم‌فاصله in توسعه‌دهنده, with Vazirmatn and RTL shaping.
rtlDecisions.why: These are literal on-screen role labels; Persian role wording is clearer and avoids leftover English.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept physical attachment, all Bezier control points, left/right entry and exit, upper/lower exchange arcs, and pointer SVG unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The motion tells the design-to-development handoff through actor position; mirroring the choreography would change the authored scene rather than localize reading order.

rtlDecisions.action: Applied FaRoot plus isolated RTL text styling with zero letter spacing and preserved badge light/dark opacity, saturation and glow formulas.
rtlDecisions.why: Persian labels need contextual joining while the badge lighting remains the source's dialogue handoff cue.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original easeIn enlargement, scale, centerward motion, crop and final 140-frame endpoint unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The giant pointer is a physical transition mask, not text or a reading-direction sweep.

comps.rasterHandling: None. The scene uses generated CSS glow and inline SVG cursors; no raster asset contains text.
comps.timing: All source timing, easing, arc phases, handoff frames 70–84, badge fades, giant-arrow scale and 140-frame duration are unchanged.
